label: Bible Study
prompt: Glory to God in the _____, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verse: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
note: The angels' song over Bethlehem's shepherds — the original Gloria in Excelsis.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his _____ continually.
verse: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
note: Sung the day David brought the ark into Jerusalem — seek His face, and keep seeking it, continually.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Go to the ant, thou _____; consider her ways, and be wise:
verse: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
note: Solomon's productivity seminar: one ant, no supervisor, and a lesson for every sluggard.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Beat your _____ into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verse: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
note: Joel flips Isaiah and Micah's famous peace line into a call to arms for the valley of decision.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the _____ that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verse: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
note: Saved 'to the uttermost' — completely, all the way through — because he 'ever liveth to make intercession.'
